title: Process Power
coreMove: Look for an interlocking activity system that rivals cannot copy one routine at a time.
sourcePressure: Process power is rare. It appears when deeply embedded, interlocking activities produce lower cost or better product and rivals would need prolonged commitment to match the whole system. Operational excellence alone does not qualify.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Process power means being efficient, disciplined, lean, or having good standard operating procedures.

sourceAnchors.name: operational excellence
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar explicitly says operational excellence alone does not qualify as process power
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A clean checklist is not process power until it is tied into a system that a rival cannot lift out and install next week.
